en: Create a contact form for a website
Collect confirmed email consent in the CRM
Build a registration or feedback form
de: Ein Kontaktformular für eine Website erstellen

en.question: Does a form need a brand?
en.answer: No. Forms are standalone team resources and are created without a brand.

en.question: Can a form collect confirmed marketing consent?
en.answer: Yes. Enable CRM email consent to create the contact, send a confirmation email, and track consent status.

en.question: Can other teams install my form?
en.answer: Yes. Publish it in the Form store to make it installable.

de.question: Braucht ein Formular eine Marke?
de.answer: Nein. Formulare sind eigenständige Team-Ressourcen und werden ohne Marke erstellt.

de.question: Kann ein Formular bestätigte Marketing-Einwilligungen erfassen?
de.answer: Ja. Aktiviere die CRM-E-Mail-Einwilligung, um Kontakte anzulegen, eine Bestätigungs-E-Mail zu senden und den Status zu verfolgen.

de.question: Können andere Teams mein Formular installieren?
de.answer: Ja. Veröffentliche es im Formular-Store, damit es installiert werden kann.

description.en: Update a site’s enabled state, name, URL, custom domain, type (undefined|shop), contact, metrics source/resource, monthly report schedule, or uptime monitoring.

warp.bot: Update site fields including optional type and custom domain. customDomain sets the site’s own bare hostname (e.g. example.com, no protocol) and must be unique across teams. type=shop requires url, only works on brandless sites, and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team). Pass type=undefined (or empty) to clear shop. For metricsSource=analytics, pass analyticsDomains as the public hostname JSON array; metricsResource is optional because JoAi generates a site key when needed. For Cloudflare and Google Search Console, pass metricsResource as the zone tag or property URL. monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month job when contact and metrics are set — it does not send immediately. uptime=true enables uptime monitoring with a public status page; it requires url or custom domain and a paid plan (free plans return 402). Native analytics needs no third-party integration. If another source returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with its integration, then retry.

en.question: How do I connect a custom domain to a site?
en.answer: Pass the bare hostname, for example example.com, as the custom domain. It must be unique across teams.

de.question: Wie verbinde ich eine eigene Domain mit einer Website?
de.answer: Gib den nackten Hostname an, zum Beispiel example.com. Er muss teamübergreifend eindeutig sein.
